exposure: Number of previous cesarean sections (CS) (none, one, two or more)
cohort: 115 women undergoing a planned cesarean section
finding: Women with multiple previous cesarean sections had lower preoperative HRQoL and experienced more postoperative health problems compared to women with fewer or no previous cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was significantly associated with both pre- and postoperative HRQoL.
